name: storage-health
description: storage-health CLI surface. Schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the Connect-RPC proto descriptors at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

groups.name: validate
groups.description: Validate a scenario's storage judgment (schema layout, isolation safety, persistence hygiene)

commands.name: scenario
commands.description: Run the applicable static storage analyzers against a scenario and report normalized findings

groups.name: fix
groups.description: Preview or apply deterministic storage autofixes (DB_ROWS_NOT_CLOSED, ENSURE_SCHEMAS_NOT_WIRED)

commands.name: preview
commands.description: Preview the deterministic storage autofixes for a scenario without writing anything

flags.name: rule
flags.description: Restrict the fix to one or more finding codes (repeatable / comma-separated)

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply the deterministic storage autofixes for a scenario (idempotent)

flags.name: rule
flags.description: Restrict the fix to one or more finding codes (repeatable / comma-separated)
